title: Equality in the Fradelizi–Paouris–Schütt second-moment inequality
completion_scope: Assigned adversarial mathematical review; worldwide novelty not estimated
strongest_verified_result: For every n>=1,r>0 and compact convex K with nonempty interior whose actual extreme points have norm>=r, C2(K)>=[r^2+(n+1)||gK||^2]/(n+2), equality iff K is a nondegenerate n-simplex with all vertex norms r. The unstrengthened corollary and retained finite strictness bound are supported. Countable-shell and distinct finite-witness proof routes independently reconstructed.
